svg.aria-label: The platform: Git holds the desired state and Argo CD applies it to a four-layer stack on EU infrastructure; operations agents answer alerts within a policy and ask the operator for anything else; recovery paths sit outside the platform.
svg.title: One cluster, defined in Git, watched by agents

svg.text: Off-site backups · break-glass access · a failover DNS zone: every recovery path lives outside the thing it recovers.
